title: The Pink Octet
description: Eight pink stones give the earrings their name — an octet, arranged so the colour repeats and answers itself across the pair. Set among white diamonds in eighteen-karat white gold, each pink reads warmer for the cool brilliance around it, the contrast sharpening rather than softening the colour. Earrings move with the face, and these were built for it: the eight stones catch and release light with every turn of the head, keeping a soft flush of pink at the jawline through the evening. Delicate in scale, deliberate in effect.
subtitle: Eight points of pink, caught in white and set swinging.
